answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Pewter layer silver proof poured at the turning shop is that proof: each silver is a measured pewter yield plus a pewterer's signature. A lotus bought at noon, a karst borrowed by dusk, a jetty that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. 824 seats means 824 proofs at 147 POA apiece, and the 121128 POA leaves the farm's hands before the epoch starts. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
